name: griddata
expr: vq = griddata(x, y, v, xq, yq); [Xq, Yq] = meshgrid(2:0.5:4, 2:0.5:4); Vq = griddata(x, y, v, Xq, Yq);
comment: Sig: vq = griddata(x, y, v, xq, yq) — scattered-data interpolation onto a 2-D grid (default linear, via Delaunay triangulation). Scalar query + meshgrid query. Bit-comparable (1e-9 tol) with MATLAB R2025b on collinear input — points lie on y=x line, vq is interp on the line. Method argument ('linear'/'cubic'/'nearest'/'natural'/'v4') and 3-D form deferred.
